title: The Live Map
content: Every pin on this map is a live branch. Colour tells you its health — green is safe, yellow is at risk, red is critical. Let's interact with one.

title: Click Bangalore
content: Click the Bangalore marker to zoom in and filter the view to that branch.

title: Branch Containers
content: The list has updated to show only Bangalore containers. Find Container T-161 and click it to inspect its details.

title: Open Container T-161
content: Click this container row to drill into its sensor readings and full history.
